explanation: The statement is about `RS.retractionSection`, which the library defines itself as `cokernel.desc k (𝟙 N - r ≫ k) _`. The theorem says this section composed with `r` is zero. All of its content comes from that definition, and the proof only uses `cancel_epi`, `cokernel.π_desc` and routine algebra. Mathlib does build splittings from a retraction (`ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction`), but its section is constructed differently. I found no Mathlib lemma that states this fact about `cokernel.desc k (𝟙 N - r ≫ k)`.
